get.summary:
GET /i18n/bundle/:lang?since=version. Bypasses the global
ResponseInterceptor's {data:...} envelope deliberately (@Res()
without `passthrough`, per Nest's documented raw-response-control
pattern) — that's the only way to send a spec-correct empty-body 304
for a matching ETag (docs/01_FOUNDATION_AUTH.md §9.3: "Поддержка
ETag/304"). Every other route in this module returns normally and
gets the standard envelope.

ETag/304 is the plain-GET HTTP-cache path (no `since`): if the
client's If-None-Match matches the language's current version, 304
with no body. `since` is the separate, explicit delta-poll path
(§9.3: "полный или дельта-набор + version") — it always returns 200
with a (possibly empty) JSON body, never a 304, since it's a
versioned query the client is actively asking for, not a cache
revalidation.

info.title: LawBid API
info.description: LawBid — US legal-services marketplace. Every 2xx JSON body is the envelope {data, meta?: {nextCursor}} and every error is {error: {code, message, details?, requestId}} with `code` from the ErrorCode enum — docs/01_FOUNDATION_AUTH.md §7.

message.description: Human-readable, not localized and not stable — never branch on it.

app_config.description: Public app_config values (min versions, store URLs, ...).

translations_version.description: Current bundle version per language code.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

sent.description: Always true: the code was sent.

linkChallenge.description:
Magic-link binding (email login only): base64url SHA-256 of a random
verifier that stays on the requesting device. The emailed link then
carries a one-time token redeemable only together with that verifier
(POST /auth/otp/verify-link), so a leaked link is useless. Omit it and
the email contains the code only.

refreshToken.description: Opaque rotating refresh token; store in secure storage only.

isNewUser.description: True when this call created the account.

sessionId.description: Session chain id (stable across refresh rotations) — the id DELETE /auth/sessions/{id} takes.

isCurrent.description: True for the session making this request.

reauthToken.description: Single-use token for the X-Reauth-Token header of a sensitive action; expires after REAUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS (5 min).

otpauthUri.description: otpauth:// URI for the QR code.

ticket.description: Short-lived proof that the email code was accepted; exchange it with the TOTP code (or a recovery code).

totpEnrollment.description: Present on the first sign-in (or after a 2FA reset): bind the authenticator app, then send its code to /totp.

expiresAt.description: Absolute expiry (8 h); the session also ends after 30 min idle.

recoveryCodes.description: Only right after the authenticator was bound: ten one-time recovery codes, shown once.

oldestAgeSeconds.description: Age of the oldest waiting request, seconds.

computedAt.description: When the numbers were computed (cached ≤ 60 s).

reason.description: Internal reason (audit + moderation_actions); the user gets the moderation_notice template.

licenses.description: All of the attorney's licenses with their status.

request.description: The latest request, or null if none yet.

identityRequired.description: Identity document and selfie are required (false for an already verified attorney adding a state, §2.1).
